description: Turns a real captured webhook into code to build a handler around: typed models of its payload, a fixture file with the body, and a test that posts it to the handler. Languages: typescript (types + Jest/Vitest test), python (dataclasses + pytest), php (DTO + Laravel test), go (structs; no test). Returns file contents with suggested names; it writes nothing, so save them with your own file tools. Also says which signature scheme the endpoint checks, so the handler can verify it.

event_id.description: Which event: its number (12 or "#12", from list_events or the dashboard), "latest", "latest <event type>" such as "latest invoice.paid", or the provider's own event id such as evt_1Qx...

parts.description: Which files to generate. Default: all three

target_url.description: The handler URL the test posts to. Default: the endpoint's relay URL, or http://localhost:3000/webhooks

name: generate_handler
title: Generate handler code
